name: After § 4
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 4b. Considers that such a strategy should be based on an assessment of the threat of entryism across the EU Member States and in the EU institutions, in line with initiatives undertaken at national level, as well as on a mapping of funding flows, including scrutiny of foreign funding, and the systematic identification of vulnerabilities within its own institutions, including in the context of the European Democracy Shield;
